# Morph & Co. KG – Die Wörterfabrik

Morph & Co. KG is a German-linguistics escape room on morphology for one or two players. The word factory has stopped its production: switch off the alarm, find out what is broken, repair the affix sorter A-12 and the inflection line F-04 with your knowledge of word classes, affixes and morpheme types, and restart the production. The game is in German; an English interface is available, the language examples stay German.

## Requirements

Desktop Windows, macOS, or Linux. Mobile devices are not supported. Bundled downloads are available for Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64. On macOS, use the JAR with Java 25 or newer.

## Start

### With Java 25 or newer

Download `MorphCo.jar` and run:

```sh
java -jar MorphCo.jar
```

### Without Java installed

- Windows: Extract `MorphCo-win-x86_64.zip` and start `MorphCo/MorphCo.exe`.
- Linux: Extract `MorphCo-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` and start `MorphCo/bin/MorphCo`.

## Single Player

Press **Schicht beginnen**, enter a name and start the game, everything is set up. The host saves a checkpoint after every solved step. Use **Fortsetzen** in the main menu to continue.

## Multiplayer

Both players need their own computer on the same local network. Start the game on both computers. One player hosts the game; the other joins and enters the host's displayed IP address. Internet play and local split-screen are not supported.
